$comment: Exports of @xoroh/kern-primitives that exist in the built barrel but have no
first-party consumer yet. Each entry is a DELIBERATE decision, not an absence:
an export with no consumer and no entry here fails `check:consumption`.
A unit is a group of exports that ship together. Its `symbols` must cover every
export in the unit -- a new symbol added to an adopted unit still has to be
listed, so widening an existing unit cannot quietly escape the gate.
Removing an entry is the point of this file: the gate then demands a real
consumer, which is what turns adoption from a claim into a measurement.

units.reason: NOT VERIFIED TO QUALIFY. No audit has established that any native menu or tree holds real collection state. Scheduling it on assumption is how the 6 phantom rows of P2b-3 happened.
